heloc-five-years.title: The Five-Year Promise
heloc-five-years.music: original synthesized motorik marimba score (stops one bar before the $833 reveal) plus synthesized foley
heloc-five-years.topic: HELOC interest-only payments: five years in, the $50,000 balance has not moved
heloc-five-years.hook: Five years of HELOC payments, and the balance is still $50,000.
heloc-five-years.logline: Sixty interest-only payments land in sixty months and the $50,000 balance never moves; divide it into sixty pieces and the promise finally has a number: about $833 a month plus interest.
heloc-five-years.structure: One 'statement page' that re-flows each beat: note row, orange balance slab, statement line, 60-month grid, caption row. Setup 0-18s (stuck balance, interest only, FCAC survey: over 25% mostly pay interest, 62% expected payoff in 5 years), turn 18-38s (slab splits into 60 orange cells = $833/mo + interest), ending 38-53.5s (check your statement, message me; cells cut to $0 or snap back to frame 1 for the loop). All text in y 280-1240.
heloc-five-years.device: giant orange balance slab that holds still over a 60-month grid, then splits into 60 orange cells (one cell = $833) and snaps back into the opening frame; score stops one bar before the reveal
rejectedStyles: spreadsheet (12px software chrome vanishes on a phone)
bauhaus-shapes (its demo is already a compounding-finance film)
dataviz (charts read as homework in a reel)
rejectedStructures: odometer: one locked balance counter for 50s, nothing changes
promise-vs-reality split spread: two half-width pages make both numbers small and it shows the answer before the question
lessons: Caption file says: label as AI voice (Instagram AI label), add brokerage name and licence # in the caption for Ontario clients, use poster.jpg (frame 1) as cover, upload at highest quality.
Whisper hears 'HELOC' so Kokoro is fed 'heelock' for the spoken word; keep that respelling.

heloc-piggy-bank.title: Your Home Is Not a Piggy Bank
heloc-piggy-bank.music: generated score at 120 BPM (1 bar = 2s), a chord per numbered rule
heloc-piggy-bank.topic: HELOC rules: credit line secured by the home, 65%/80% limits, variable rate, interest-only, borrow with purpose, tax deductibility
heloc-piggy-bank.hook: A HELOC is not free money.
heloc-piggy-bank.logline: A calm narrator shows a homeowner that a HELOC is a credit line with their house as the collateral, and that the house is the one who pays when the rules are ignored.
heloc-piggy-bank.structure: Rules card with a held presenter and a house that reacts. 0:00-0:34 setup (money rains on a grinning house, stamp says no, what a HELOC is, the 65%/80% wall), 0:34-1:28 three numbered rules each a medallion the camera irises through (variable rate, interest-only, borrow with purpose), 1:28-2:00 tax warning, homeowner on a mustard rotary phone, dead-still end card for 3s. Placeholder CTA 'Your Name · Mortgage Agent'.
heloc-piggy-bank.device: the house as a second character with a face (grin, worry, sweat, sag, calm) plus numbered medallions the camera irises through; off-register cel colour; one ground colour per scene
rejectedStructures: straight explainer: eight cards in a row with nothing changing about the homeowner
before/after of one homeowner: adds a second story and pushes past two minutes
lessons: Longest reel (101s at 24 fps); later HELOC reels cut to about 55s at 30 fps.
Its end card is a dead-still 3s starburst with a placeholder CTA, not a loop.

heloc-rules.title: HELOC Quest: A HELOC is not free money
heloc-rules.topic: HELOC rules: collateral, 65%/80% limits, variable rate, interest-only minimums, borrow with purpose, tax
heloc-rules.hook: A HELOC is not free money.
heloc-rules.logline: A homeowner opens a chest of gold that turns out to be chained to his own house, and has to learn three rules on the road before he can bring the chain home.
heloc-rules.structure: Quest up a vertical overworld. Setup 0-16.9s (gold, chain, what a HELOC is, 65%/80% limits drawn inside the house), rising 16.9-34s (Trial 1 Prime Storm = variable rate, Trial 2 Balance Slime = interest-only hits for 0 damage), turn and peak 34-43.9s (renovation builds a room; palette drains to grey, only the gold chain keeps colour; REPAYMENT PLAN floods colour back), ending 43.9-57.3s (sage: tax-deductible? usually only if used to earn income; choice menu 'Thinking about a HELOC? MESSAGE ME'; chest lid closes into frame 1).
heloc-rules.device: each HELOC rule becomes a game mechanic: a chain from gold to house in every shot, a hit that does 0 damage, an HP bar that will not move, palette collapse to grey, native 180x320 framebuffer at x6 with whole-frame x2 close-ups
rejectedStyles: microgame (needs 5-6 mini art engines, frenzy outruns caveats)
paper-popup (heavy 3D, house too close to the piggy-bank film)
rejectedStructures: item shop and inventory: static, no travel or turn
turn-based duel with a mimic chest: frames HELOC as a trap, one screen for 50s
lessons: PLAYBOOK 'How the first three reels measure up': it ends on a generic 'Message me' choice menu; cut it and loop instead.
Safe area: text runs down to about y 1480, below the y 1248 bottom limit.
AI label: Kokoro TTS voiceover, so apply Instagram's AI label when posting.
Audio bitrate: the _ig file carries about 192 kbps AAC; re-encode to 128 kbps if posting through the API.
Frame rate: 24 fps (pixel-rpg STYLE.md sets it); new work should be 30 fps.

keep-your-rate.title: Keep Your Rate
keep-your-rate.music: synthesized toy-pop score that stops dead twice and swells to brass for the scale reveal
keep-your-rate.topic: Refinance vs HELOC or second mortgage when you hold a 3-4% mortgage and need $100K cash
keep-your-rate.hook: Got a 3-4% mortgage and need cash? Don't refinance the whole thing. Not yet.
keep-your-rate.logline: A homeowner with a gold tower of five $100K bricks at 3-4% needs one more brick and nearly lets a REFINANCE wrecking ball knock the whole tower down to get it.
keep-your-rate.structure: One tower's near-miss. Setup 0-14s (hook, tower = $500K at 3-4%, need = one red $100K brick), turn 14-25s (wrecking ball swings, silence, collapse, prepayment penalty, then the film rewinds it), resolution 25-44s (red brick of HELOC or second mortgage snaps on top, caveats, see-saw: sometimes refinancing still wins), payoff 44-55s (crane to the kitchen-table calculator: run the numbers). Ends on the ball swinging in again = frame 1.
keep-your-rate.device: gold tower of five $100K bricks, a brick wrecking ball labelled REFINANCE, a real rigid-body collapse then stop-motion rewind, one red brick snapped on top; camera on ones, bricks and character on twos
rejectedStyles: data-physical (needs a published statistic with source line)
bauhaus-shapes (explains the ratio, not the temptation)
rejectedStructures: countdown of mistakes: a list with no through-line or turn
before/after split: two half-width towers, answer shown before the question
lessons: PLAYBOOK 'How the first three reels measure up': it ends on a generic 'Message me' end card; cut it and loop instead.
Safe area: text runs down to about y 1480, below the y 1248 bottom limit.
AI label: Kokoro TTS voiceover, so apply Instagram's AI label when posting.
Audio bitrate: the _ig file carries about 192 kbps AAC; re-encode to 128 kbps if posting through the API.
Frame rate: 24 fps (Brick Toy rate); new work should be 30 fps.

mortgage-insurance.title: Mortgage insurance is not a penalty
mortgage-insurance.music: synthesized score where every floor letter and prop rings a vibraphone or pizzicato note in key; silences at 12.4s and 40.6s
mortgage-insurance.topic: Canadian mortgage default insurance: under 20% down, protects the lender, enables 5% down, premium tiers, example $500K at 5% down, sales tax paid in cash
mortgage-insurance.hook: Mortgage insurance is not a penalty.
mortgage-insurance.logline: A first-time buyer with only 5% saved walks one street to her front door and discovers that the insurance she thought was a penalty is the thing that lifts the barrier.
mortgage-insurance.structure: One street to the door. Setup 0-12s (under 20% down needs default insurance; the shield rises behind the bank, not her), turn 12.4-18.9s (silence, barrier sign flips 20% to 5%, barrier lifts on the downbeat), honest costs 19-40s (premium bars 4.00 / 3.10 / 2.80%, $19,000 crate on a $475,000 loan = $494,000, sales tax paid in cash at the closing counter), payoff 40.6-53.2s (door opens, roof lifts off, camera runs back to the start where the next buyer stands = loop).
mortgage-insurance.device: one continuous isometric street with each key number painted on the floor as the narrator says it; a barrier that flips from 20% to 5% and lifts; roof lifting off the house; faceless buyers as the diagram
rejectedStyles: memphis-diorama (a place you watch, not a story you follow)
tilt-shift (people become dots, text on signs unreadable)
rejectedStructures: two buyers two ways with a rewind: turns into advice to buy sooner
penalty ticket myth that turns: list of flips, no travelling subject
lessons: PLAYBOOK 'How the first three reels measure up': it ends on a generic CTA/'Message me' card; cut it and loop instead (the film already loops back to the start of the street).
Safe area: text runs down to about y 1480, below the y 1248 bottom limit.
AI label: Kokoro TTS voiceover, so apply Instagram's AI label when posting.
Audio bitrate: the _ig file carries about 192 kbps AAC; re-encode to 128 kbps if posting through the API.
Frame rate: this one is already 30 fps (heloc-rules and keep-your-rate are the two 24 fps files).

portfolio-failing.title: 3 Reasons Your Portfolio Could Be Failing (Brian Wang)
portfolio-failing.topic: Investing in Canada: inflation, active funds trailing the TSX, tax structure (TFSA vs non-registered)
portfolio-failing.hook: 3 REASONS YOUR PORTFOLIO COULD BE FAILING (two-line headline in the strap over Brian on frame 1)
portfolio-failing.logline: A Toronto wealth coach runs a three-item bulletin on why a portfolio quietly fails: inflation, fund performance (93-96% trailed the TSX), and tax structure ($5,000 gain costs about $1,000 in a non-registered account, $0 in a TFSA).
portfolio-failing.structure: Round-up bulletin cut from Brian's own 4K talking-head footage: rundown becomes a persistent 1/3-2/3-3/3 tracker; full-frame inserts (split-flap CPI board, proportion bars, GUESS card then REVEAL 93-96% slam, tax card) cover jump cuts; the rundown returns ticked as a comment prompt 'Which one hits you: 1, 2 or 3?'; DM bubble types INVEST onto his brand card. 55.75s.
portfolio-failing.device: persistent 1/3 2/3 3/3 tracker in the package row; guess-then-reveal board; split-flap boards; comment-vote recap; DM-keyword CTA (INVEST) carried onto the brand card; punch-ins at 1.10-1.20x anchored at head top
rejectedStructures: cold open on the biggest number: breaks his spoken order
countdown 3 to 1: needs re-ordered audio and loses his own signposts
lessons: User waivers for this client only: on-camera presenter, burned-in captions and a brand end card are allowed here although PLAYBOOK forbids them elsewhere.
Graphic text stays at y <= 1248; face region y 590-1490 is kept clear of graphics and the IG right rail.

hukam-reel.title: Hukam (crayon-book version)
hukam-reel.music: soft synthesised harmonium drone on Sa = 92.5 Hz, ducked about 4 dB under speech
hukam-reel.topic: Hukam: a 57s devotional talk in romanised Punjabi on accepting both joy and sorrow (non-mortgage, not a client piece)
hukam-reel.hook: Je sukh dey, taan tujhe aaraadhi, dukh bhi tujhe dhiyaayi.
hukam-reel.logline: A speaker's own video sits under a live-drawn crayon page that illustrates each verse; the page drops over him for about 2s to explain.
hukam-reel.structure: Layout 1080x1920: crayon-book page in the top 720px (seven pages of live-drawn graphics), the speaker's own video in the lower 1330px, hand-lettered Roman captions at the bottom. Full-screen moments where the page drops over him. 1367 frames at 24 fps.
hukam-reel.device: wax-crayon material physics (wax only on paper-tooth peaks, strokes boil on twos, hatched fills with overshoot, one watercolour wash resisted by white wax); page drops over the speaker to explain
lessons: Same audio and layout as hukam-urban; compare the two styles side by side before choosing.
24 fps; new work should be 30 fps.

hukam-urban.music: soft synthesised harmonium drone, ducked under speech
hukam-urban.topic: Hukam: a 57s devotional talk in romanised Punjabi on accepting both joy and sorrow (non-mortgage, not a client piece)
hukam-urban.hook: Je sukh dey, taan tujhe aaraadhi, dukh bhi tujhe dhiyaayi.

C1.device: the Declined Pile: bank files stamped DECLINED (textured red rubber stamp), each holding the one document that sank it; Greenbrix's lime file tab reopens them and runs from the cover into slide 2 as the seamless join
C1.structure: 7 slides 1080x1350: cover (Krystian behind a stamped folder, lime sticky 'Not the final answer.'), business owner (tax return, declared income circled), rebuilder (credit gauge needle under 600), non-traditional earner (slips spilling out of a bank form), out of time (calendar), what we look at instead (property, equity, plan dividers), CTA index card on a lime YOUR FILE folder.
lessons: BoC stat (about 9% of Toronto-CMA borrowers renewing in 2027 may be unable to refinance) is caption-only; wording must name the Financial Stability Report 2026 and say Toronto-area.
Confirm licence numbers #13645 and M12001607 on the FSRA register before posting.

C2.device: the bill pile: every debt is a perforated payment stub; an adding-machine tape runs the math and crosses the seam from slide 3 to 4 (1,350+400+560+300=2,610, then 105,000 x 11.99% / 12 = 1,049.13)
C2.structure: 7 slides: stub-pile cover with $2,610 struck in lime and a green $1,049 slip crossing the edge, four stubs, $2,610 hero with tape, one green slip, about $1,560 freed with before/after stacked bars, 'The debt is still there' with 12 months as a brick wall, CTA with Krystian.
lessons: Title says 'Five payments' but the plan lists four debts; slides say four. Client must confirm four or supply the fifth.
build.mjs throws if the checked math drifts.

C3.device: The Rail: one day-by-day timeline of logo bricks runs along the bottom of slides 1-4 and continues across every slide edge as a seamless panorama (Today, Day 1, Day 15+ Notice of Sale, five week-bricks for 35 days)
C3.structure: 7 slides: Krystian with rail starting at TODAY, giant '1' with lender letter and missed-call card, Notice of Sale document stamped 15+ days, 7x5 brick calendar of 35 days, rail forks into 4 options, equity vs mortgage brick wall with the arrears brick, CTA with disclaimer.
lessons: Caption claim 'Ontario's mortgage delinquency rate rose 52% in a year' is SOURCE NEEDED; cite it or delete before posting.
Disclaimer 'General information only, not legal advice' appears on slide 7 and in the caption.

C4.device: a thermal cost statement that prints one line per slide, hung from a printer slot, with a steel loupe doing real optical magnification of the newest line; a brick meter COSTS LISTED 1/4 to 4/4 and a TOTAL, FULL TERM line that stays blank until the CTA stamp IN WRITING
C4.structure: 7 slides: loupe reading 'NO FINE PRINT' on the receipt, rate, lender fee, broker fee, legal and appraisal, receipt vs the alternative (lost deposit, power of sale, 20% cards), TOTAL slip stamped IN WRITING with Krystian. Loupe handle crosses the 1-2 seam.
lessons: Three yellow placeholders must be filled by the client before posting: [X% to Y%] private rate range, [X%] lender fee, [How Greenbrix charges] broker fee basis.

C5.device: masonry arch of the logo's dark-to-lime bricks with a lime keystone; the arch crosses the seam between slides 6 and 7 and lands at 'Funds arrive' where Krystian stands
C5.structure: 7 slides: whole arch between 'Your deadline' and 'Your funds' (right foot runs off the edge as swipe cue), SOLD / FOR SALE lawn signs with a gap arch, split-flap status board (Lender: pulled out), cheque stamped DUE NOW, giant 90% over ten bricks with the tenth missing, joined arch across slides 6-7. Fields alternate so no two neighbours match until the joined finale.
lessons: No rates, fees or terms appear, so no placeholders were needed.

C6.device: architect's massing models drawn as isometric SVG: context buildings in white card, each deal built from Greenbrix bricks (logo gradient with running-bond mortar); cover shows all four deals on one plinth under a giant lime '4'
C6.structure: 7 slides: four deals on a plinth, rentals with a dashed BANK LIMIT wall, storefront with apartments above, staked land parcel with NOTICE sign, fixer with scaffolding, deal sheet, CTA with Krystian. Slides 2-3 end with a BANK / GREENBRIX strip.
rejectedStructures: icon tiles on a deal grid (previous attempt, replaced)
lessons: Cover copy changed from 'We fund them' to 'We look at them.' to avoid promising approval.
'You'll get a yes, a no or a number, quickly' is a service promise the client must be comfortable with.
